name: Fēngsè Huànxiǎng III: Zuì Yǔ Fá de Zhènhúngē
storyline: A long time ago, in order to end the war between mankind and the goblins, the savior Gasedo used the seven original sin badges of the ancient evil god Disya to seal the six holy spirits of the chaotic world, but The power of the seven original sin badges left by the savior Gasedo who did his best to seal the six holy spirits would be revived and the prophecy of destroying the world before he died. In order to resist this catastrophe, mankind gathered elites from all over the world to form an organization dedicated to eliminating the scourge of the seven original sins, the "Wings of Judgment".
summary: Wind Fantasy 3: The Soul Song Of Sin & Punishment is a strategic role-playing game developed by Hongyu Technology, released on November 17, 2004.
